Transaction schema (GatedTransition):

```
GatedTransition {
  tx_type: u8 = 0x01 (GATED_TRANSITION_V1)
  nonce: u64            // caller nonce, only consumed on APPLY
  sender: [32]byte      // node/agent id (ed25519 pubkey)
  gate: Gate            // precondition
  op: Op                // the state operation to apply iff gate passes
  max_gate_cost: u32    // bound on gate evaluation steps
  sig: [64]byte         // ed25519 over canonical bytes of all above
}
```

Gate schema:

```
Gate ::= 
  | TRUE                      tag 0x00
  | FALSE                     tag 0x01
  | KEY_EQ     {key, value}   tag 0x02   // state[key] == value (missing ⇒ refuse)
  | KEY_LT     {key, value}   tag 0x03   // state[key] <  value as u256 BE
  | KEY_LE, KEY_GT, KEY_GE   tags 0x04–0x06
  | KEY_EXISTS {key}          tag 0x07
  | WEIGHT_GE  {threshold}    tag 0x08   // sum of weights of pre-attesting signers ≥ threshold
  | HEIGHT_IN  {lo, hi}       tag 0x09   // lo ≤ header.height ≤ hi
  | TIME_IN    {lo, hi}       tag 0x0A   // header.timestamp (unix ms) within [lo, hi]
  | SENDER_EQ  {id}           tag 0x0B
  | SENDER_IN_CAP {cap_key}   tag 0x0C   // state[cap_key] is a capability list containing sender
  | AND {left: Gate, right: Gate}  tag 0x10
  | OR  {left, right}              tag 0x11
  | NOT {inner}                    tag 0x12
```

With bounded size: encoded gate ≤ 4096 bytes; depth ≤ 32; evaluation cost model: each node costs 1 step, KEY_* cost 1 + 1 (lookup), max_gate_cost caps steps; exceeding cost ⇒ REFUSED(GATE_COST_EXCEEDED) — deterministic.

Op schema (the transition body):

```
Op ::=
  | PUT    {key, value}        tag 0x20
  | DELETE {key}               tag 0x21
  | TRANSFER {from_key, to_key, amount:u256}  tag 0x22   // requires state[from] ≥ amount, else REFUSED
  | BATCH  {ops: []Op}  (≤ 64, total ≤ 64 KiB)  tag 0x23
  | WEIGHT_UPDATE {id, new_weight}  tag 0x24  // gated: requires current holder sig or gate
```

Op application can also refuse (e.g., TRANSFER insufficient funds) — refusal codes unify.

Receipt:

```
Receipt {
  tx_index: u32
  outcome: u8   // 0x00 APPLIED | 0x01 REFUSED
  code: u16     // refusal reason
  gate_cost: u32
}
```

Receipt vector is committed in the block header as receipt_root but is NOT part of state_root. State root changes only on APPLIED ops.

```
EVAL(g, S, ctx) -> (bool, cost)   # ctx = {sender, header(height, time), attestations}
```

Exact pseudocode:

```
def eval_gate(g, S, ctx, budget) -> (bool, remaining_budget):
    if budget <= 0: return REFUSE(GATE_COST_EXCEEDED)
    match g.tag:
      TRUE: return (True, budget-1)
      FALSE: return (False, budget-1)
      KEY_CMP(op, k, v):
        if k not in S: return REFUSE(GATE_MISSING_KEY)   # missing key ⇒ gate false, code GATE_MISSING_KEY
        x = S[k] as u256 BE (must be exactly 32 bytes else REFUSE(GATE_TYPE))
        return (cmp(x, v) per op, budget-2)
      KEY_EXISTS(k): return (k in S, budget-2)
      WEIGHT_GE(t):
        w = sum(ctx.attest_weight[signer] for signer in ctx.attestations if signer in WeightTable(S))
        return (w >= t, budget-2)
      HEIGHT_IN(lo,hi): return (lo <= ctx.height <= hi, budget-1)
      TIME_IN(lo,hi): return (lo <= ctx.time_ms <= hi, budget-1)
      SENDER_EQ(id): return (ctx.sender == id, budget-1)
      SENDER_IN_CAP(k):
        if k not in S: return REFUSE(GATE_MISSING_KEY)
        caps = decode_caplist(S[k]); return (ctx.sender in caps, budget-2)
      AND(l,r): (b1, bud) = eval(l,...); if not b1 return False; (b2,_) = eval(r,...); return b1 and b2   # short-circuit, deterministic
      OR(l,r): symmetric
      NOT(i): return not eval(i)
```

Note: REFUSE inside gate eval (missing key, cost) short-circuits to REFUSED with that code — deterministic. Also attestations: the tx may carry `attestations: []Sig` over tx hash by other swarm members; WEIGHT_GE sums their weights. These attestations are part of the tx (so they're in consensus payload), deterministic. Good — that's the "flock" part: a gate can require a quorum of the flock to pre-attest.

```
def apply_tx(S, tx, ctx) -> (S', receipt):
    # Tier-1 validity already enforced at block admission
    # Tier-2:
    if tx.sender_nonce_expected(S) != tx.nonce: return (S, REFUSED(NONCE_MISMATCH))
       # define expected nonce: state[key("nonce", sender)] as u64, default 0 if absent
    (ok, code, _) = eval_gate(tx.gate, S, ctx, tx.max_gate_cost)
    if not ok: return (S, REFUSED(code))
    (S1, r) = apply_op(S, tx.op, tx.sender)
    if r.outcome == REFUSED: return (S, r)          # op refusal ⇒ whole tx refused, no nonce consumed
    S2 = S1 with nonce[sender] += 1                  # nonce consumed ONLY on success
    return (S2, APPLIED)
```

**Invariant R (Refusal Purity):** For any state S, tx t, context c: if apply_tx(S,t,c).outcome == REFUSED, then apply_tx(...).state' == S exactly (byte-identical canonical encoding), hence root(S') == root(S). apply_op:

```
def apply_op(S, op, sender) -> (S', receipt):
    match op.tag:
      PUT(k,v): return (S[k↦v], APPLIED)
      DELETE(k): if k not in S: return (S, REFUSED(OP_KEY_MISSING)); return (S\{k}, APPLIED)
      TRANSFER(f,t,a):
        if f not in S: return (S, REFUSED(OP_KEY_MISSING))
        bal = S[f] as u256; if bal < a: return (S, REFUSED(OP_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS))
        S1 = S[f ↦ bal - a]; S2 = S1[t ↦ (S1[t] or 0) + a]; return (S2, APPLIED)
      BATCH(ops): 
        S' = S
        for op in ops: (S', r) = apply_op(S', op, sender); if r is REFUSED: return (S, REFUSED(OP_BATCH_CHILD_REFUSED, child_code=r.code))
        return (S', APPLIED)
      WEIGHT_UPDATE(id, w):
        auth_key = key("weight-auth", id)
        if auth_key not in S: return (S, REFUSED(OP_WEIGHT_UPDATE_UNAUTHORIZED))
        if sender not in decode_caplist(S[auth_key]): return (S, REFUSED(OP_WEIGHT_UPDATE_UNAUTHORIZED))
        return (S[key("weight", id) ↦ u64(w)], APPLIED)
```
